name: Car Accident
description: Repair cost of the insured vehicle damaged in a road accident or collision

name: Vehicle Theft
description: Settlement on Insured Declared Value when the vehicle is stolen or declared a total loss

name: Vehicle Fire
description: Damage to the insured vehicle caused by fire explosion or self-ignition

name: Glass Damage
description: Repair or replacement of broken windshield windows and mirrors

name: Third Party Insurance
description: Legal liability for damage to third party property vehicle or person caused by the insured vehicle

name: Breakdown & Towing
description: Towing flat tyre fuel delivery and on-road breakdown assistance

name: Vehicle Vandalism
description: Damage to the insured vehicle caused by malicious acts riots or strikes

name: Engine Damage (Flood)
description: Add-on cover for engine and gearbox damage from water ingression after flooding

name: Driver Personal Accident
description: Compensation for death or disability of the owner-driver in a vehicle accident

name: Pay As You Drive
description: Discontinued usage-based motor plan; no longer sold to new customers

name: Hospital Admission
description: In-patient hospital admission of 24 hours or more including room rent doctor and nursing charges

name: Pre & Post Hospital Expenses
description: Medical expenses incurred before admission and after discharge for the same illness

name: Surgery
description: Planned or emergency surgical procedures including surgeon anaesthesia and operation theatre charges

name: Accidental Injury
description: Treatment of injuries and fractures resulting from an accident

name: Critical Illness
description: Lump-sum benefit on first diagnosis of a listed critical illness such as cancer or heart disease

name: Maternity
description: Delivery newborn and maternity related hospital expenses

name: Home Treatment
description: Discontinued cover for home treatment; now handled under Hospitalization

name: Emergency & Ambulance
description: Emergency room treatment and ambulance transport charges

name: Doctor Consultation
description: Out-patient doctor consultation diagnostics and day-to-day treatment

name: Medicine Expenses
description: Reimbursement of prescribed medicines purchased during treatment

name: Home Fire Damage
description: Damage to the building or contents caused by fire lightning or explosion

name: Water Leakage Damage
description: Damage caused by burst pipes leakage or overflow of water tanks

name: Home Burglary
description: Loss of contents following theft involving forcible entry or house-breaking

name: Flood & Storm Damage
description: Damage to the property caused by storm cyclone flood or inundation

name: Jewellery Theft & Loss
description: Loss or damage of declared jewellery and valuables kept at the insured premises

name: Property Vandalism
description: Damage to the property caused by vandalism riot or strike

name: Electrical Appliance Damage
description: Damage to household appliances and wiring due to short circuit or power surge

name: Building Structure Damage
description: Damage to walls roof or foundation caused by an insured peril

name: Household Goods Damage
description: Loss or damage to furniture electronics and household goods

name: Visitor Injury Liability
description: Discontinued liability cover for injury to visitors on the insured premises

name: Term Life Insurance
description: Financial benefit to the nominee in the event of the insured person's death during the policy term

name: Whole Life Insurance
description: Life coverage for the insured person's lifetime subject to the policy terms and conditions

name: Endowment Policy
description: Life insurance coverage with a maturity benefit payable if the insured survives until the policy maturity date

name: Group Life Insurance
description: Life coverage provided to eligible employees or members of an organization under a group policy

name: Accidental Death Benefit
description: Additional benefit payable to the nominee when death results from a covered accident

name: Critical Illness Life Cover
description: Lump-sum benefit upon diagnosis of a covered critical illness when the policy conditions are met

name: Child Education Plan
description: Life insurance and savings benefits intended to support a child's future education expenses

name: Joint Life Insurance
description: Life coverage for two insured individuals with benefits determined by the selected joint-life policy terms

name: Money Back Policy
description: Periodic survival benefits payable at specified intervals during the policy term subject to policy conditions

name: Legacy Savings Plan
description: Discontinued life savings product; no longer offered to new customers

name: General Liability
description: Coverage for eligible third-party bodily injury or property damage claims arising from business operations

name: Professional Indemnity
description: Coverage for eligible claims arising from professional negligence errors or omissions

name: Workers Compensation
description: Coverage for eligible employee work-related injuries or occupational illnesses as provided by the policy

name: Business Interruption
description: Coverage for eligible loss of business income resulting from an insured interruption

name: Cyber Insurance
description: Coverage for eligible financial losses and incident response costs resulting from covered cyber incidents

name: Commercial Property Damage
description: Coverage for insured business premises equipment or inventory damaged by a covered event

name: Commercial Vehicle Fleet
description: Coverage for eligible accidents damage and liability involving insured business vehicles

name: Product Liability
description: Coverage for eligible third-party claims involving injury or damage caused by covered products

name: Marine Cargo
description: Coverage for insured business goods during covered transportation by sea air or land

name: Legacy Business Protection
description: Discontinued business insurance product; no longer offered to new customers
